subject: Is there a way to get a list of htmlwidgets that work with crosstalk?

messages.author: a5edeb4fa89b826c
messages.subject: Is there a way to get a list of htmlwidgets that work with crosstalk?
parts:
I looked all around www.htmlwidgets.org for a way to get a list of htmlwidgets that support crosstalk.  There wasn't even a "crosstalk" tag used on any widgets in the htmlwidget gallary at http://gallery.htmlwidgets.org/ .

Any ideas?

Thanks in advance.

Joel

messages.subject: Re: Is there a way to get a list of htmlwidgets that work with crosstalk?
parts:
Thanks Dean.  I'm thinking that list of 3 packages (Plotly, Leaflet, at DT) are just a few examples because, on that same site at https://rstudio.github.io/crosstalk/shiny.html, the crosstalk examples use 2 packages:  d3scatter and ggplot2 (and do not use Plotly, Leaflet, or DT).

I'll definitely keep an eye on that page as it has an invitation for htmlwidget authors to add their widgets to the list.
